## Coaching athlete upsert + members access

Both coaching branches (Private via Route by Product, CoachMatch via Parse CoachMatch Hire) feed ONE normalizer, so downstream nodes have a single node name to reference.

**Update path writes conversion fields ONLY** -- name, sport, leadSource, preferredLanguage, phones and athleteLevel are left alone, because a CoachMatch athlete is normally already a lead with real data in those fields.

Home doc: `athlete-onboarding-flow.md` section 3.3

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customerType: 'OPT1_1_COACHING', leadStatus: 'WON_CUSTOMER', signUpDate: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.signUpDate, coachingStartDate: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.coachingStartDate, planPurchased: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.product, churnDate: null }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ name: { firstName: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.firstname, lastName: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.lastname || '-' }, emails: { primaryEmail: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.email }, customerType: 'OPT1_1_COACHING', leadStatus: 'WON_CUSTOMER', signUpDate: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.signUpDate, coachingStartDate: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.coachingStartDate, planPurchased: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.product }, $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.leadSourceOnCreate ? { leadSource: $('Normalize Coaching Athlete').item.json.leadSourceOnCreate } : {})) }}
